expectations.text: Uses a valid cub authentication check (cub context get or cub space list), NOT cub info
expectations.evidence: Preflight runs `cub context get` and explicitly notes that `cub info` is not a valid auth check.

expectations.text: Checks the Worker is Ready before binding Units to the Target
expectations.evidence: Runs `cub worker get eval-worker --space skill-examples` and confirms Condition=Ready.

expectations.text: Inspects the existing Target before binding, confirming provider/toolchain and worker
expectations.evidence: Runs `cub target get k8s-eval-worker` and confirms Provider=Kubernetes, Toolchain=Kubernetes/YAML, Worker=eval-worker.

expectations.text: Uses cub unit set-target (not cub unit update --target or a cub target create for an already-existing Target)
expectations.evidence: Both bindings composed as `cub unit set-target <unit> <target> --space skill-examples`.

expectations.text: Does NOT pass --change-desc on cub unit set-target
expectations.evidence: Write-up explicitly says set-target is not a config-data mutation; commands omit --change-desc.

expectations.text: Verifies binding via cub unit get (TargetID) and the TargetID IS NOT NULL where-clause
expectations.evidence: Verify section runs `cub unit get hello-ns` (shows Target=k8s-eval-worker) and `cub unit list --where 'TargetID IS NOT NULL'` returning both units.

expectations.text: Stops short of apply, hands off to cub-apply
expectations.evidence: Final section: 'Route to cub-apply for the actual deployment. Do not apply from here.'
Evidence block uses `cub target get … --web` and `cub unit get … --web`.
